articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement on SWE-Bench over GPT-4o and significantly reduced hallucination rates on factual retrieval tasks. The model is available via API with a new structured-output guarantee mode aimed at enterprise agent workflows.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves Silver-Medal Performance on International Math Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 solved 4 out of 6 problems on a held-out set of recent IMO-level competition problems, reaching silver-medal equivalence without human-in-the-loop assistance. The system uses a novel chain-of-verification architecture that iteratively checks proof steps against a formal verifier. This marks a significant milestone in AI-driven formal mathematical reasoning and has implications for automated theorem proving in research mathematics.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude's Real-Time Computer Use Agent for Enterprise IT Automation
articles.summary: Anthropic expanded Claude's computer-use capabilities into a fully autonomous IT operations agent that can navigate enterprise software, execute multi-step workflows across applications, and handle exception cases with human escalation protocols. Early deployments at Fortune 500 companies report 60% reductions in tier-1 IT support ticket resolution times. The system includes comprehensive audit logging and role-based access controls designed for SOC 2 compliance.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in BMW and Amazon Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla's third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has entered pilot deployment at BMW manufacturing facilities in South Carolina and Amazon fulfillment centers in Texas, performing bin-picking, parts transport, and quality inspection tasks. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22 degrees of freedom per hand and a new vision-language-action model trained on over 100,000 hours of teleoperation data. Initial reports indicate the robots can operate autonomously for 14-hour shifts with minimal human intervention.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Electric Achieves Parkour-Level Agility in Unstructured Construction Sites
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics released video demonstrations and technical documentation showing its electric Atlas robot navigating active construction environments, climbing scaffolding, traversing debris fields, and carrying 30kg payloads up ladders. The system uses a reinforcement-learning locomotion policy trained in simulation and fine-tuned with real-world data, enabling robust recovery from unexpected perturbations. Several major construction firms have signed pilot agreements for site inspection and materials transport applications.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Partners with Microsoft to Deploy AI-Powered Humanoids in Data Center Operations
articles.summary: Figure announced a partnership with Microsoft to deploy its Figure 03 humanoid robots in Azure data centers for server rack installation, cable management, and hardware swap-out procedures. The robots leverage a Microsoft-trained foundation model for spatial reasoning and tool use, reducing mean-time-to-repair for hardware failures by an estimated 45%. The collaboration signals growing industry confidence in humanoid robots for precision infrastructure tasks.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node, Enabling Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed it has begun high-volume manufacturing on its N1.4 gate-all-around (GAA) transistor process, delivering approximately 35% power efficiency gains and 20% performance uplift over the N2 node. First customers include NVIDIA and Apple, with AI accelerator and mobile SoC designs expected to tape out in Q1 2027. The node's improved transistor density—over 300 billion transistors per reticle—will be critical for scaling next-generation large language model inference chips.

articles.title: Breakthrough Solid-State Battery from QuantumScape Achieves 600 Wh/kg in Independent Testing
articles.summary: QuantumScape announced that its latest solid-state lithium-metal battery cells achieved 600 Wh/kg energy density in independent third-party testing, roughly doubling the density of current commercial lithium-ion cells. The cells maintained over 80% capacity after 1,000 fast-charge cycles, addressing a long-standing durability concern for solid-state designs. If manufacturing scales as planned through a partnership with Volkswagen's PowerCo, the technology could transform EV range, robotics endurance, and portable electronics by late 2027.
